name: rogen-multiplace
description: Multi-place Roblox game template: roblox-ts + Rogen feature folders + Flamework

scripts.build:lobby: rogen -c places/lobby/.rogen.json -m ts build && rbxtsc -p tsconfig.lobby.json --rojo places/lobby/default.project.json --includePath places/lobby/include
scripts.watch:lobby: rogen -c places/lobby/.rogen.json -m ts build && concurrently -n rogen,rbxtsc "rogen -c places/lobby/.rogen.json -m ts watch" "rbxtsc -p tsconfig.lobby.json --rojo places/lobby/default.project.json --includePath places/lobby/include -w"
scripts.dev:lobby: rogen -c places/lobby/.rogen.json -m ts build && concurrently -n rogen,rbxtsc,argon "rogen -c places/lobby/.rogen.json -m ts watch" "rbxtsc -p tsconfig.lobby.json --rojo places/lobby/default.project.json --includePath places/lobby/include -w" "argon serve places/lobby/default.project.json"
scripts.build:match: rogen -c places/match/.rogen.json -m ts build && rbxtsc -p tsconfig.match.json --rojo places/match/default.project.json --includePath places/match/include
scripts.watch:match: rogen -c places/match/.rogen.json -m ts build && concurrently -n rogen,rbxtsc "rogen -c places/match/.rogen.json -m ts watch" "rbxtsc -p tsconfig.match.json --rojo places/match/default.project.json --includePath places/match/include -w"
scripts.dev:match: rogen -c places/match/.rogen.json -m ts build && concurrently -n rogen,rbxtsc,argon "rogen -c places/match/.rogen.json -m ts watch" "rbxtsc -p tsconfig.match.json --rojo places/match/default.project.json --includePath places/match/include -w" "argon serve places/match/default.project.json"
